SSA Office in the South Bronx (Concourse Village West), Bronx

The South Bronx Social Security Administration field office is located at 820 Concourse Village West, 3rd Floor, Bronx, NY 10451. It serves residents of Mott Haven, Highbridge, Concourse, Melrose, and the south-central Bronx. This page covers the address, subway access, neighborhoods served, services available, and tips for making your visit efficient.

The quick answer

The South Bronx SSA office is located at 820 Concourse Village West, 3rd Floor, Bronx, NY 10451. Closest subway: Yankee Stadium-161st Street (B, D, 4 trains). It serves Mott Haven, Highbridge, Concourse and surrounding areas. The office handles all SSA services including SSN cards, SSDI, SSI, retirement, and Medicare. Open Monday-Friday 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Local appointment line: 1-855-531-1684; national: 1-800-772-1213. Appointments are now required for most in-person services as of 2025.

Open in Google Maps →

Neighborhoods served

The South Bronx field office at 820 Concourse Village West, 3rd Fl, Bronx, NY 10451 primarily serves residents of Mott Haven, Highbridge, Concourse, Melrose, and the south-central Bronx. Each Bronx SSA office is assigned specific ZIP codes; this office covers ZIP 10451 and adjacent ones. To confirm whether this is your assigned office for a specific service, enter your ZIP code at ssa.gov/locator or call 1-800-772-1213.

That said, for most routine services any Bronx SSA office can help — you do not strictly need to visit the one assigned to your ZIP, though more complex local cases may require it.

How to get there by subway

The closest subway access is Yankee Stadium-161st Street (B, D, 4 trains), then a short walk to the office at 820 Concourse Village West, 3rd Fl, Bronx, NY 10451. New York City's subway is the most reliable way to reach any Bronx SSA office — street parking in the area is limited and time-restricted.

If you are coming from outside the Bronx, allow extra time during weekday rush hours (7-9 AM and 4-6 PM) when service is more variable. Plan for half a day total when traveling from another borough: most appointments take 15-30 minutes, but travel plus security screening adds up.

Services available at the South Bronx office

Every Bronx SSA field office handles the full range of Social Security services. At the South Bronx location you can apply for a first-time Social Security card, replace a lost card, change the name on your card, apply for disability benefits (SSDI and SSI), apply for retirement, enroll in Medicare, get a Social Security number for a newborn, and handle most immigration-related changes to your record.

Some services can also be completed entirely online at ssa.gov without visiting any office — replacement cards for qualifying applicants, retirement applications, address changes, and benefit verification letters. Visit the office in person for services that require original documents or for situations where face-to-face guidance is helpful.

Before visiting this office

  • Call 1-855-531-1684 (local line for the South Bronx office) or 1-800-772-1213 (national) to schedule an appointment. As of January 2025, the SSA requires appointments for most in-person services.
  • Bring ORIGINAL documents — never photocopies. They will be photocopied at the office and originals returned the same day.
  • Arrive 15 minutes early for federal building security screening.
  • Mondays and the day after a federal holiday are the busiest — Tuesday-Friday mid-morning has shorter waits.
  • If you need bilingual service, request a Spanish-speaking representative when you book the appointment.

Frequently asked questions

What is the local phone number for the South Bronx office?
The local number is 1-855-531-1684, which routes to the South Bronx field office. You can also use the national SSA line at 1-800-772-1213 to schedule appointments or get general information.
What if I cannot get to the South Bronx office?
The other Bronx SSA field offices are: East Bronx (1380 Parker St), Hunts Point (1029 E 163rd St), Laconia Avenue (3247 Laconia Ave), and others. For most services, any Bronx office can help — confirm by calling 1-800-772-1213 or using ssa.gov/locator.
Are appointments now required?
As of January 6, 2025, the SSA requires appointments for most in-person services at all field offices, including the Bronx locations. Walk-ins for limited services may still be accepted but expect long waits. Schedule by calling 1-800-772-1213 or the local office line.
Is the office wheelchair accessible?
Yes. All SSA field offices, including this one, meet federal accessibility standards. If you need additional assistance, mention it when scheduling the appointment.
